# SARIF schema fixture

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 JSON schema,
retrieved on 2026-10-01 from
https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json.
Only JSON whitespace was normalized. It is retained for offline export validation;
no test downloads a schema or follows remote references. The owning specification
and its notices are at
https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/sarif-v2.1.0-os.html.
